scope: Immutable git-show inventory for the sealed v6 source pins. Every changed path is hashed from its target commit bytes and assigned a bounded source role. No live working-tree status, generated-output hash, Player acceptance, capacity support, or H1 claim.

headRoles.hybridclr: native runtime/metadata executable and metadata head
headRoles.il2cpp_plus: native IL2CPP runtime executable and metadata head
headRoles.hybridclr_unity: managed package/runtime executable and metadata head
headRoles.hybridclr_demo: executable head for linked Player/tool source; separate metadata head for documentation/managed source delivery

semanticRoles.meaning: Blob/raw metadata reader bounds, stream validation and sentinel handling
Image admission, ownership, publication and lifetime
Native capability/capacity query endpoint and ABI-facing data
Managed profile, manifest, capacity and capability runtime
Managed DTO/profile2 migration and atomicity consumer tests
Demo Player probes, fixtures, scenes and diagnostic assembly
Python/native test harnesses and strict verifiers
Demo profile/source pin settings in the immutable commit
Versioned documentation/evidence files in the executable delta

documentationBoundary.status: Pending final delivery update; deliberately excluded as a live HEAD artifact
documentationBoundary.metadataHeadProof: The demo metadata head is immutable commit c5a3ac689f1a2c964f98a084f49e97ae3cee4cf2, not the live status file.
documentationBoundary.sourceInventoryAccounting: The superseded draft counted the accepted-metadata-base-to-metadata-head cumulative range (305 records); this sealed inventory uses the one-file incremental metadata range and reports unique paths separately.

pathAccounting.definition: Each delta path is hashed from immutable git-show bytes at its range head. The demo metadata range is incremental from the executable head to the metadata head; an overlap is counted as a duplicated version entry, not as another unique repository path.
